| condition | accuracy | correct | trunc_rate | null_count | non_trunc_acc |

| dense     | 0.74     | 37/50   | 0.16       | -          | -             |

- s030 是系列最差，accuracy 仅 4%，比 s025 (8%) 进一步下降
